technique_name: Discuss the implications of the U.S. withdrawing from the Paris Agreement.
description: The US withdrawal from the Paris Agreement, a landmark United Nations climate change treaty, carries significant implications. First, the US has removed itself from a global effort to reduce emissions of heat-trapping "greenhouse" gases, mainly from burning fossil fuels such as coal and oil. This means the US will be releasing more emissions and will not have any mandatory controls to reduce emissions. This in turn could lead to rapid increases in global temperatures and drastic climate change.
